grades.reason: It says MXR (with SUM, MPRV, etc.) can determine whether a CMO instruction may access a cache block, like a load or store. It never says that MXR makes execute-only pages readable, so it only helps a little.

grades.quote: Changes to the `sstatus` fields SUM and MXR take effect immediately, without the need to execute an SFENCE.VMA instruction.
